name: billion-context
description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens)  and small context windows (a 100K context is enough), billion-context is all you need .

latest_release.name: v0.1.213
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* [PR] fix: revert self-contradictory inclusive billing stamp to split (#5515) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5518
* [PR] docs(website): add blog post 'What to Do When the Model Keeps Treating Old Compressed Content as New User Instructions?' | docs(website): add blog post '模型总是把压缩老内容当成用户新指令咋办?' (EN+ZH) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5549
* [PR] fix: read Responses additional_tools preamble in tool reachability observation by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5528
* [PR] fix: replay unsigned thinking when the upstream does not sign it (#5495) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5496
* [PR] fix(copy): false-advertising sweep of ACP tool surfaces (host-side) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5556
* [PR] Fix renamed model id lookups (Qoder Desktop) + clarify Qoder Desktop host boundary by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5611
* [PR] ci-fixes -> master: converge master CI gate fixes (#4599 sentinel sync @ f9cec9fb) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5358
* [PR] fix(compress): return no-op for covered external-summary ranges (#5558) by @Maziar123 in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5560
* [PR] fix(google): treat a namespaced model id as a model-API path by @Devil-muhan in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5594
* [PR] fix: preserve CLI help and version before subcommand dispatch by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5607
* [PR] feat: bili kiro — Kiro CLI launcher lane (#5532) by @meetvaghani12 in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5533
* [PR] docs: clarify that BILI_SUBAGENT_SPLIT is ineffective on the Responses pipeline | docs: 说明 Responses 线路上 BILI_SUBAGENT_SPLIT 无效 by @whickerpoplawski-arch in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5452
* [PR] fix(native): refuse oversized direct model requests (#5405) by @Hcc32 in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5406
* [PR] fix(claude): resolve magpie gateway integration and Claude Code native bypass (#5369) by @wosnxn123 in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5372
* [PR] fix(kernel): false-advertising batch — real schemas, aligned prompts, '..' separators (#5555) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5559
* [PR] Make evidence-less window fallbacks visible: warn when a model resolves to nothing (#5490) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5493
* [PR] Unified Announcement Panel: Built-in Registry + Local JSON Files + Remote Dynamic Sources (Done in One Pass) | 统一公告面：内置注册表 + 本地 JSON 文件 + 远程动态源（一次做完） by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5575
* [PR] feat(guardrail): soft-stop repeated calls, hard-abort at backstop (#5505) by @growlf in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5514
* [PR] fix(cache): prevent mid-session generation-boundary false positives and register pi tools in before_agent_start by @xulongwu4 in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5497
* [PR] fix: use personaSplit to disable the instructions fingerprint fork in Responses | fix: 用 personaSplit 关闭 Responses 的 instructions 指纹分叉 by @whickerpoplawski-arch in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5453
* [PR] feat(storage): run the store on bun's builtin bun:sqlite by @chidea in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5435
* [PR] fix: show full OpenCode V2 reports without model context pollution by @FineFenng in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5316
* [PR] fix(storage): name the failing operation when unified-store ingest fails (#5627) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/5628
* [PR] fix: expire stale upstream alert rows after 5 mi
